parsed.explanation: Combined federal and state regimes impose state threat-framing and universal birth-sex exposure: federal facilities, passport and entry screening, plus state facilities, shelters and prison placement, with a trespass arrest example and a criminal drag-performance law carrying felony repeat penalties, upheld on appeal. No documented execution or imprisonment for being trans alone, and some orders are enjoined and national employment/hate-crime law exists, but functioning courts here enforce hostile rules, custody abuse is documented, minors' care is banned, and this state has no statewide non-discrimination protection. Consequences after outing are arrest, misgendered custody, denial of shelter/care and possible permanent immigration consequences, materially above friction-only regimes.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary sex definition, X/mismatched passport processing stopped, Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025; entry cable directs refusal on document discrepancy/doubt and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation of sex.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; passport policy challenged in court.
entry_documents.interaction: Passport mismatch can trigger secondary screening, refusal and fraud inquiry, then detention and birth-sex placement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections policy from 2026: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men. State 2026 Act mandates prison placement by birth sex.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No case, ruling, special unit or segregation practice for trans prisoners in this state is sourced.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Bathroom trespass or drag arrest leads to birth-sex custody, with documented national custody harms compounding state placement.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal ban on gender-identity facilities in government-funded single-sex facilities; state April 2026 Act requires birth-sex facilities and bars trans women from women's shelters; 2019 statute defines identity-congruent bathroom use as indecent exposure, enforcement not sourced.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states plus capital district have no mapped ban, but this state does; some federal orders enjoined, status varies by facility.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Universal exposure at every government building, school, shelter and transit facility; visitor cannot avoid by discretion.

care_services.exposure: Gender-affirming care barred under 18, existing care required withdrawn, $25,000 provider actions and penalties for adults assisting minors, upheld by national Supreme Court June 2025; care ban for inmates April 2024.
care_services.protection: Adult emergency/routine care restrictions not documented in state evidence; several national orders challenged/enjoined.
care_services.interaction: Adult with minor: minor denied care, guardian exposed to civil penalties; medication interruption in custody documented nationally.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: 2023 adult-cabaret law criminalises male/female impersonators viewable by children: first offence up to 11m29d/$2,500, second felony 1-6 years; upheld by appeals court, Supreme Court declined review. Application to trans visitors' everyday presentation unresolved.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: District court found law vague/overbroad 2023; unrelated signage requirement struck down 2022; separate suit ongoing.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State criminal performance law plus federal fraud/facility rules create overlapping arrest exposure in public, lodging and events.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor care ban, birth-sex school sports/facilities litigation, mandatory teacher reporting of name/pronoun requests to parents, criminal-prosecution directive for teachers facilitating transition.
minors_guardians.protection: School bathroom and sports litigation ongoing without final disposition sourced; some national directives enjoined.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor faces facility, school-program and healthcare exclusion; guardian may face assisting-care penalties.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2021 reporting of police/legal officials turning blind eye to assaults, discrimination, refusal and beatings; gay/trans panic defence remains available; state agency recorded only 0-2 anti-trans incidents 2019-2021 with no denominator.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State hate-crime statute covers sexual orientation since 2001 but does not list gender identity; 2019 AG opinion allows gender-based enhancement; national hate-crime statute applies.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Weak local recourse plus panic defence reduces response if outed traveller is assaulted; killing rate figure is an undercount floor and not used as prevalence evidence.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No statewide employment/housing/public-accommodations protection; national remedies slow, uneven, and courts upheld drag and minor-care bans; enforcement status of 2026 facility/shelter Act not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.protection: National employment ruling, civil-liberties passport suit, legal-aid FAQ, and occasional injunctions show courts sometimes intervene.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies exist on paper but do not reliably prevent arrest, eviction from shelter, or birth-sex placement before departure.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar universal stops, fines and ineffective complaints, but this case is lower: documented criminal trespass arrest with men's-ward detention, felony drag repeat penalty, mandated birth-sex prison/shelter placement and permanent-ineligibility inquiry exceed short detention without imprisonment.

Similar birth-sex prison placement with assault risk and brief custody, but this case is slightly higher: no documented systematic raids/extortion of visitors, trespass requires willful entry plus refusal to depart, and some federal orders remain enjoined/challenged.

Higher than 0.55: that anchor is ward placement with delays and working advocacy; here exposure is criminalised, spans entry, facilities, shelter, custody and minors' care, and remedies upheld the hostile laws rather than overturning refusals.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is cumulative: document discrepancy at entry can become fraud inquiry, facility use can become trespass/indecency exposure, and any detention is routed to birth-sex custody with documented national harms. State drag and minor-care laws, upheld by higher courts, remove effective remedy. Protections are national, partial and contested, and do not pre-empt state/federal enforcement at borders, facilities or custody. For a minor, care and school exposures add guardian liability. Overall consequence after outing is arrest, misgendered detention, shelter and care denial, short of systematic imprisonment or execution.
